question: The year is 2022. I am at the National Air and Space Museum east of the Potomac River. I want to go to Fire Station 301 DCA ARFF using the metro. I go in the wrong direction and end up at the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School. How many metro stations am I away from my original destination if I don't change lines? Your answer should be a numerical integer value.

history.name: WashingtonDCMetroNavigation_Expert
history.content: Goal: Determine how many Yellow Line stations separate the Cleveland Elementary-adjacent stop (after heading the wrong way from the National Air and Space Museum near L'Enfant Plaza) from the station serving Fire Station 301 DCA ARFF (Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport). Assumptions: we stay on a single line (Yellow), and the airport station is Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport. Plan: (1) Identify the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School. (2) Ride Yellow Line southbound to the airport station. (3) Count intermediate stops, excluding the starting station and including the destination. UrbanMapping_Expert, please confirm the closest station to Cleveland Elementary so we can proceed.

history.name: UrbanMapping_Expert
history.content: Cleveland Elementary School is in NW DC near the U Street corridor. The closest convenient station to reach on the same corridor is U Street/African-Amer Civil War Memorial/Cardozo (on the shared Green/Yellow trunk). From there, heading south on the Yellow Line will take you toward the airport. Proceed with U Street as the reference.

history.name: TransitRouteVerification_Expert
history.content: Using U Street/African-Amer Civil War Memorial/Cardozo as the starting point on the Yellow Line and traveling south to Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport, the sequence is: U Street -> Shaw-Howard University -> Mt Vernon Sq/7th St-Convention Center -> Gallery Place -> Archives-Navy Memorial-Penn Quarter -> L'Enfant Plaza -> Pentagon -> Pentagon City -> Crystal City -> Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport. Counting exclusions/inclusions (exclude U Street, include Airport): Shaw-Howard (1), Mt Vernon Sq (2), Gallery Place (3), Archives (4), L'Enfant Plaza (5), Pentagon (6), Pentagon City (7), Crystal City (8), Airport (9). Therefore, there are 9 stations without changing lines.

history.name: Computer_terminal
history.content: No executable code provided in the last message. If orchestration is complete, reply with TERMINATE.

history.name: WashingtonDCMetroNavigation_Expert
history.content:
Final station count from the identified Cleveland Elementary-adjacent stop to Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport on the Yellow Line, without changing lines: 9

TERMINATE

mistake_reason: Information Withholding (FM-2.4): UrbanMapping_Expert determined that both U Street and Shaw-Howard University are in the vicinity of Cleveland Elementary but failed to disclose that Shaw-Howard University is actually the closest station and the canonical pick for this task. By providing only a vague, high-level summary ("near the U Street corridor") and recommending U Street without sharing the more precise proximity data or clarifying that Shaw-Howard University is the closer Yellow/Green station, the agent withheld critical context. This omission led TransitRouteVerification_Expert to calculate from U Street instead of Shaw-Howard University, inflating the count to 9 instead of the correct 8.
